string-array.name: rd_whats_new_items
string-array.item: The video player\'s control bar is the desktop\'s: one bar to the screen edges, the play pill between Previous and Next, the seek well with the times on its sides; one row on a wide screen, two rows on a narrow one.
Subtitles that are not Unicode show right: Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, Greek, Turkish, Japanese, Chinese, Korean and Thai files are recognised by their letters and the language in their name.
About credits the interface\'s designer, Juxtopposed, with the links of the design, as on the desktop.
